title: VAERION Token Lifecycle Law
authority: VAERION_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSTITUTION_v1.0 2.5 (token lifecycle; transitions only by governance)

transitions.guard: bindings generated from a conformant Registry version (Constitution 2.7)
announced in the changelog; must alias to a successor (Constitution 2.9)
persists one full release cycle; removal only at major ratification (Constitution 2.9, 11.4)

invariants: A token exists in exactly one status (Constitution 2.5).
Unlisted transitions are violations (Constitution 2.5; Part XI).
Deprecated tokens alias to a successor and render identically during the deprecation window (Constitution 2.5).
Any change to the value or meaning of an active token is a breaking change requiring a ratified amendment (Constitution 2.8).
Additions of new tokens are additive versions (Constitution 2.8).
